Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 8  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made an error in the analysis of the comparison of the directors' ages. The birth year of Nunzio Malasomma (1894) is earlier than that of Don McGuire (1919), making Malasomma the older director. However, the Planner incorrectly concluded that Don McGuire was older based on the ages at the time of the film releases, rather than comparing birth years directly. This led to the incorrect conclusion that Johnny Concho had the older director, whereas it should have been One Minute to Twelve.
